*.name: Display name for this power (optional; overrides the default).
*.hidden: If true, this power is not listed on the origin screen.
*.condition: Only applies while this condition passes (a DSL condition object — use pick).

neoorigins:effect_immunity.effects: List of mob-effect ids whose application to the player is cancelled.

neoorigins:particle.frequency: Emit every N ticks (20 = 1s; default 8, min 1).
neoorigins:particle.offset: [x,y,z] offset in blocks from the player to spawn at (default [0,1,0]).
neoorigins:particle.particle: Particle id, or object form like {type:minecraft:dust,color,scale}.
neoorigins:particle.speed: Particle motion speed passed to the spawn call (default 0.0 = still).

neoorigins:resource.color: Hex color (#RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB) for the HUD resource bar fill.
neoorigins:resource.label: Display name shown on the HUD resource bar (e.g. "Mana").
neoorigins:resource.max: Maximum value the resource can hold (default 100).
neoorigins:resource.max_action: EntityAction run once when the resource rises to its max.
neoorigins:resource.min: Minimum value the resource can drop to (default 0).
neoorigins:resource.min_action: EntityAction run once when the resource falls to its min.
neoorigins:resource.regen_condition: EntityCondition that must pass for regen to apply (default always).
neoorigins:resource.regen_interval: Ticks between regen ticks (20 = 1s; default 20, min 1).
neoorigins:resource.regen_rate: Amount added each regen interval; 0 disables regen (default 0).
neoorigins:resource.start_value: Value the resource starts at when first granted (default max).

neoorigins:starting_equipment.components: SNBT data-component patch applied to the granted item.
neoorigins:starting_equipment.count: Stack size of the granted item (default 1).
neoorigins:starting_equipment.enchantments: List of {id, level} enchantments applied to the granted item.
neoorigins:starting_equipment.grant_id: Unique id tracked so the item is granted only once per player.
neoorigins:starting_equipment.item: Item id granted once after the player commits their origin.
neoorigins:starting_equipment.legacy_tag: Apoli-style flat SNBT translated into data components on the item.
neoorigins:starting_equipment.stacks: Plural multi-item shape (v2.2.0): array of {item, count, enchantments, legacy_tag, components} entries granted in order; takes precedence over the singular root fields when non-empty.
